note: if/else in three languages. This case exists because the rosetta gate caught rust modelling `else` inline while python and typescript gave it a node — a shared-names violation that made `alternative:` mean different things per language and left `(_clause)` a member short. `(_clause)` is asserted here, unlike hello-roles, precisely because these programs use only the clause all three share.
field_query_note: the obvious guard, `(_branch alternative: (else_clause))`, is NOT asserted: a field pattern whose parent is a supertype accepts only a supertype child, and `else_clause` is concrete. `(_declaration body: (_body))` is asserted instead — the same shape with a supertype child — so the writable form is the one under test. See treebank-rust/ledger.json's toolchain_note for the rule and what it implies about the vocabulary.
